sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost drivers behind your offer; we value our relationship with your family-owned business and understand that larger price steps need committee approval. Our order volume represents our full demand for this part, and the long contract term and rising forecast offer planning security; could you review the base price and alloy surcharge with your pricing committee, perhaps with the owner walking us through the calculation?

We currently buy this part from another supplier at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
The price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We are pleased to accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 45-day payment terms at a unit price of €5.60.
Please note that a fixed price over three years is not feasible, which is why we must apply the AS-14404 index clause to this offer.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving toward us in your latest reply; we appreciate it, and understand that material is a significant part of your costs and that you cannot share more detail. The data cited below is the basis for our position, though we note your point that it does not relate directly to this part or your company. Our order represents our full demand for this part over the contract term, with rising forecast demand and the planning security of a long-term agreement, and our proposal below moves toward you again.

Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.83 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 0.0%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides necessary stability for a 36-month contract. In recognition of your movement, we are prepared to reduce our price to €5.40 per unit under the agreed terms.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For complete clarity, our offer consists of a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We value our business relationship and look forward to hearing from you soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
